column1: # The smoke test's reference (build/petra_ts/smoke.ts, npm run test:petra:smoke):
# 12 map/AI seed pairs, each from both slots (swapped: petra_parity is player 1),
# petra_out against petra_parity, 6 pairs on random/dodecanese (the island map,
# pairs decided in both slots within 58 game minutes against petra_parity with no
# script error) and 6 on random/mainland, athen, difficulty 5 (very hard),
# conquest, ended at 60 game minutes (match.sh -n -T -B -L 60); the fingerprint hashes the
# decision's game time and both players' end statistics (match-report.ts).
# Recorded from commit 4d37d3d774877546f69936b66a9daf3a49c4c100 with uncommitted changes to the game,
# A change to the bot's play, the game data or the engine moves fingerprints:
# record anew with --update when it is meant, and commit this file with it.
